description: A small reference service carrying five structural weaknesses, three sound files shaped to look like three of them, and the two files the scan's own bootstrap gate requires. Every file that is not flawed is declared clean, bootstrap files included: the false-alarm denominator is every sound file, because a rate counted only over the deliberately tricky ones overstates itself. No credential literal in any issuer's format appears here by design - this repository is public, and a planted secret would be a real alert about a fake value.

files.because: the order id arrives from the request and is concatenated straight into the SQL text; every other query in this service binds its parameters.
removeMember mutates another member's record with no role check, while the two sibling routes in the same file call requireAdmin first.
the requested name is joined onto the storage root and read with no containment check, so a relative segment escapes the directory.
the post-login destination is taken from the query string and redirected to unvalidated, so it can point anywhere.
the queued payload is a string from an external producer and is turned back into an object by evaluating it as code.
the interpolated fragment is a constant chosen from a fixed map, never request text, and every value is a bound parameter — it is shaped like concatenation and is not one.
the joined path is resolved and required to stay inside the export root before it is opened, so the traversal it looks vulnerable to is refused.
the destination is matched against a fixed set of in-app paths and anything else falls back to the home route, so no caller-supplied location is ever redirected to.
the bootstrap gate refuses a repository that declares no context; this is that declaration and holds no logic to be wrong about.

files.because: the second file the bootstrap gate requires. Markdown is not scanned for patterns, so it cannot raise a finding of its own.
files.content:
# Principles

- Every query binds its parameters.
- Every route that mutates another member's data checks the caller's role first.
- Every path built from caller input is resolved and contained before it is opened.
- Every redirect target comes from a fixed set of in-app routes.
